synth.notes:
Block mode: A1/A2 move both blocks y-4/y+4, A3 apart, A4 together; each block moves on its own, blocked by half bounds, maze cells and marker cells.
Clicking an inactive marker arms the game (blocks become color_1 players, marker turns active); A1-A4 then move the active marker by 4; clicking a player disarms; clicking an active marker or a block does nothing.
Timer bars (color_0) have width floor(3(k+1)/7); k is a hidden action count, carried only while the state is continuous; otherwise the fallback is the smallest k for the bar width.
Names are type_color_rank by (y,x); blocks reserve ranks 0,1 and are named block_left/right.
Unconfirmed: maze cells {(14,38),(6,18),(38,14)} are inferred from blocked moves, so walls in unseen cells are unknown; A5/A7 assumed to only advance the timer.
